column1: # PII Disclosure fires on /auth/csrf-token because the random hex CSRF token
# sometimes contains a digit run that looks like a card number: a brand prefix,
# a valid length and a passing Luhn check. Sampling 300 freshly issued tokens
# produced 3 such substrings, which is why the alert appears and disappears
# between scans. Scoped to this one URL rather than IGNOREd outright, so a real
# PII leak on any other endpoint is still reported.
